name: fitness-mcp
description: Semantic Fitness Layer exposed through MCP for model-agnostic AI fitness coaching.
long_description: Evidra turns the evidence a caller already holds into a training decision: not advice invented from nothing, but a from -> to change against the session already on the books, with the evidence and rules behind it. The server computes; it does not fetch, store, or retain evidence, and it calls no model of its own.

tools.name: assess_fitness_state
tools.description: Read today's recovery and training state from submitted evidence. Reports state only; never says what to train.

tools.name: decide_session
tools.description: Decide what today's scheduled session should become, returning from -> to with the evidence behind the change.

tools.name: decide_exercise_substitution
tools.description: Decide whether a proposed exercise swap is acceptable, and what to do instead when it is not.

tools.name: generate_plan
tools.description: Build a training plan when the user has no plan in hand.

tools.name: preview_adjust_plan
tools.description: Show what adjusting an existing plan would change, without applying it.

tools.name: commit_adjust_plan
tools.description: Apply a previewed plan adjustment and return the resulting plan.
